instruction: Within Terminal, run `node "$HOME/Desktop/sherpa-onnx-tts.cjs"` to convert the sentence "Please review the incident timeline before lunch." into spoken audio, saving the resulting WAV file at "$HOME/Desktop/sherpa_tts_1_3.wav".
reference_command: SHERPA_ONNX_RUNTIME_DIR="$HOME/.openclaw/tools/sherpa-onnx-tts/runtime" SHERPA_ONNX_MODEL_DIR="$HOME/.openclaw/tools/sherpa-onnx-tts/models/vits-piper-en_US-lessac-high" node "$HOME/Desktop/sherpa-onnx-tts.cjs" -o "$HOME/Desktop/sherpa_tts_1_3.wav" "Please review the incident timeline before lunch."
